Qwen2.5-7B.status: GATE FAILED — theta>1 numbers NOT reportable; root cause = bf16
Qwen2.5-7B.root_cause: vLLM V0 logits_processor receives logits in the model compute dtype (bf16, 7 mantissa bits). Adding +5 vs -5 is NOT order-preserving under bf16 rounding, so rare per-step argmax flips occur even at theta=1.0; they cascade autoregressively over the 200-token continuation into a large token-divergence rate. HF's run_a1.py avoids this by casting logits to fp32 before the shift. gpt2-large in fp16 shows exactly 0 flips at theta=1.0.
